summary: National Grid plc furnished a routine Form 6-K bundling two London Stock Exchange announcements. The first, dated 1 October 2026, is a monthly Total Voting Rights update: registered capital of 5,249,831,589 ordinary shares, including 222,922,601 treasury shares, leaving 5,026,908,988 shares with voting rights as the FCA Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules denominator. The second, dated 9 October 2026, is a MAR Article 19 PDMR notification disclosing CFO Andy Agg's purchase of 13 partnership shares at GBP 11.3681 (GBP 147.78 total) on 7 October 2026 under the Share Incentive Plan. No special-situation event; routine disclosure only.
